WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_sw, ty.stores, ly.stores AS ly_stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, d.fiscal_year
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id<900
),
dups AS (SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores, SUM(net_amount) AS gross_net_sales_lines FROM f GROUP BY 1),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS ctrl_stores, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_before, SUM(r.returns_net) AS ctrl_ret
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
),
ret AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ret_net, COUNT(*) AS nret, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS nret_d
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT dups.*, ctrl.ctrl_net, ctrl.ctrl_stores, ctrl.ctrl_before, ctrl.ctrl_ret, ret.ret_net, ret.nret, ret.nret_d, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900) AS phys_stores
FROM dups JOIN ctrl USING (fiscal_year) JOIN ret USING (fiscal_year)

SELECT r.store_id, st.store_name, st.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ly,
  ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END),0)-1),1) AS g,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND r.net_sales<>0 THEN r.business_date END) AS ty_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.net_sales<>0 THEN r.business_date END) AS ly_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND r.net_sales<>0 THEN d.fiscal_week END) AS ty_wk,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.net_sales<>0 THEN d.fiscal_week END) AS ly_wk
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=r.store_id AND st.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY g
